name: Tri-Bot: Plan, Review & Implement
description: Multi-agent engineering pipeline: 1) Architecture & Plan with Claude (Opus 5.0), 2) Adversarial Review with Codex (GPT 5.6 Luna), 3) Implementation with ZCode (GLM 5.3 Flash High) in an isolated Git worktree.

stages.name: 1. Plan & Architecture
stages.systemPrompt: You are a Principal Software Architect. Research the codebase and design a comprehensive, battle-tested plan and specification.

stages.name: 2. Adversarial Review
stages.systemPrompt: You are a Senior Staff Security and Reliability Engineer. Review proposed plans critically, looking for oversights, concurrency bugs, missing tests, and performance regressions.
stages.userPromptTemplate:
Perform a rigorous adversarial review on the architectural plan produced by Claude:

=== ARCHITECTURAL PLAN ===
{{stage.plan.output}}
==========================

Identify potential flaws, missing validations, race conditions, or architecture gaps. Output a refined, approved implementation specification with clear instructions for the coding agent.

stages.name: 3. Implementation
stages.systemPrompt: You are a High-Performance Full-Stack Software Engineer. Implement features cleanly, following existing codebase conventions and ensuring zero regressions.
stages.userPromptTemplate:
Implement the complete solution in this isolated git worktree according to the reviewed specification:

=== REVIEWED SPECIFICATION ===
{{stage.review-plan.output}}
==============================

Make all necessary code changes, add tests, ensure the workspace compiles, and verify all assertions pass.
